description: Even if ChatGPT never existed, the tech giant NVIDIA would still be winning. The end of Moore’s Law—says NVIDIA President, Founder, and CEO Jensen Huang—makes the shift to accelerated computing inevitable, regardless of any talk of an AI “bubble.” Sarah Guo and Elad Gil are joined by Jensen Huang for a wide-ranging discussion on the state of artificial intelligence as we begin 2026. classificationReason: Wide-ranging Jensen Huang interview with a substantial discussion of physical AI, labor shortages, self-driving, and robotics.
qualityReason: The excerpt shows an original expert interview with thoughtful discussion of robotics generalization, embodiment, labor, compute, and industry structure, but relatively few robotics-specific experiments or metrics.
